name: Sekolah Islam Ibadurrahman Ciruas Serang
address: Kp. Kubangawan RT 002/RW 002, Citerep, Ciruas, Kabupaten Serang (RA & SDIT); Perum Bumi Ciruas Blok C8 No.14–15, Ranjeng, Ciruas (SMPIT & SMAIT)

notes.id: Total SPMB: Early Bird 1 Rp4.850.000 / normal Rp6.850.000 (SPP bulanan di luar total). Uang pangkal = infaq bangunan Rp3.000.000 + sarpra Rp1.000.000 (harga normal); diskon early bird dihitung dari total. RAIT Waladun Sholih.
notes.en: Total admission cost: Early Bird 1 Rp4,850,000 / normal Rp6,850,000 (monthly tuition separate). Entry fee = building donation Rp3,000,000 + facilities Rp1,000,000 (normal price); the early-bird discount applies to the total. RAIT Waladun Sholih.
